# shibumistack.dev

> Source, tests, agent instructions, and VPS deployment config for static, Bun web, and SQLite projects.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.md)
- [Documentation index, Markdown](/docs/index.md)
- [Roadmap](/building.md)
- [Shibumi Forms](/forms.md)
- [shibumi-server](/server.md)
- [Ship an existing project](/ship.md)
- [DX plan](/dx.md)
- [Brand](/brand.md)

## Available

- [`create-shibumi`](/docs/cli.md): creates SQLite full-stack apps, Bun web apps, and static sites with VPS deployment.
- [Extensions](/extensions.md): add bundled auth, email, or uploads source with `bun run shibumi add <name>`.
- [Shibumi Forms](/forms.md): hosted pre-alpha and self-hosted form collection for static sites using plain HTML, Bun, Hono, and SQLite.
- [`shibumi-server`](/server.md): open-source VPS deployment service for exact locally built images, rootless Podman, Caddy, health checks, bounded rollback, and project-owned Ship source.
